Engage with us

ARC Linkage Project funds six projects with FEIT researchers
Six projects involving FEIT researchers have received funding through the Australian Research Council (ARC) Linkage Projects 2025 Round 2. Four of the projects were led by FEIT, securing $1.98 million of the $99.8 million awarded nationally this round.
